caches.purpose: Data that every worker process must see: login sessions (a user's requests land on any worker) and the raw metadata documents written by the sync job. File-backed under var/cache/, atomic replace on write, no expiry; callers delete explicitly.

Parsed metadata objects. Parsing the few-hundred-kilobyte JSON document costs about 40 ms and Python objects cannot be shared between processes, so each worker keeps its own parsed copy for up to a minute.

could_remove_local.consequence: svc/metadata.py would json.loads the raw document from the shared cache on every request, adding roughly 40 ms of parsing to each metadata-dependent request per the module's own note; removing it without replacing it moves the cost into the request path rather than eliminating it. The shared cache cannot take over because it holds text, not parsed objects.
